concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-verification-requirements]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Business Accounts additional verification-data and US onboarding-disclosure guide, with country/entity/conditional document scope and a linked US FATCA/CRS exception; data collection is not KYC or account-opening proof.
warnings: The main page's organization FATCA/CRS bullet omits the linked detailed reference's exemption for US-based legal entities applying for US business bank accounts; read together before applying.
US-specific CIP before personal-data collection, ToS acceptance and Regulation GG certification timing are distinct captured requirements, not a current-law determination or proof of completion.
